text: Acceptance 4: truncating within one wiki line leaves pominiete=0, so wiki_read marks unseen content as fully read and unlocks replacement. In-memory test: save 'x'.repeat(50000)+'TAIL', read as Bob, then save only the visible prefix => tailDelivered=false, last_revision_id=1, writeAccepted=true. Track intra-line truncation and never mark a partial read complete; require a full read or an explicit overwrite.
